input.quote: (e) not use the Work except as authorized herein;
input.rationale: Searches for "audit", "inspect", "verify", "records", "premises" and "monitor" return no verification or inspection right binding Sparkling. Restrictions on Use (§ 3, including (a)-(g)) imposes only substantive use limits with no compliance-audit, reporting or system-access mechanism; General Matters (§ 20) covers only time-of-the-essence and notices; Confidentiality (§ 14) references accounting records only as protected Confidential Information, not as an audit right; Fees (§ 11) contains no usage-verification or true-up right. Because Garman has no audit or inspection right against us, and no right of access to our systems, there is nothing to constrain and the AUDIT rule's risk (frequency, notice, cost allocation, system access) does not arise. Adding audit language would create a customer obligation that does not currently exist, so no redline is proposed.
